name: Forked Lightning
description: The arrow hits an enemy, then lightning forks from its body to nearby enemies

name: Wind Lance
description: A charged shot that turns the arrow into a javelin of wind: fast and dead straight with no drop, passing through enemies and knocking them back

name: Snipe
description: Charge a powerful shot: the longer the charge, the more damage. Drains stamina while charging and slowly zooms in on the target

name: Multishot
description: One shot splits into several arrows in a fan; uses one arrow

name: Strafe
description: Hold to rapid-fire: the bow draws once (a crossbow needs only to be loaded), then keeps firing where you aim for as long as you hold

name: Freezing Arrow
description: Frost damage and a short freeze in an area on impact; bosses are only slowed

name: Immolation Arrow
description: Explodes in fire on impact and leaves the ground burning

name: Venom Strike
description: The arrow bursts into a poison cloud where it lands, poisoning everything that stands in it

name: Shackle Shot
description: Shackles the target to an enemy or a tree behind it, stunning both; with nothing behind it, only briefly

name: Inner Sight
description: Nearby enemies glow and take more damage for a while

name: Critical Strike
description: Chance to deal double physical damage

name: Penetrate
description: Chance for a hit to ignore the creature's resistance to its damage type

name: Dodge
description: Chance to avoid a melee hit while standing or attacking

name: Avoid
description: Chance to avoid a projectile while standing or attacking

name: Evade
description: Chance to avoid any hit while moving

name: Decoy
description: A tinted, standing copy of you that creatures attack instead

name: Valkyrie
description: A tinted copy of a player character that fights for you

name: Pierce
description: Chance for an arrow or javelin to pass through and hit the next enemy

name: Jab
description: A fast series of thrusts

name: Impale
description: One heavy thrust; wears the spear down faster

name: Fend
description: Thrusts at several nearby enemies in turn

name: Charged Strike
description: The thrust releases small lightning bolts around the target

name: Lightning Strike
description: The thrust releases chain lightning to nearby enemies

name: Lightning Bolt
description: The javelin (a spectral copy) turns into lightning

name: Poison Javelin
description: The javelin (a spectral copy) leaves poison clouds along its path

name: Plague Javelin
description: A spreading poison cloud where the javelin (a spectral copy) lands

name: Lightning Fury
description: The javelin (a spectral copy) bursts into lightning bolts on impact
